meta.description: Debug Python code execution failures by capturing partial traces, isolating failing functions, and incrementally verifying outputs

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果调试 Python 程序时经常找不到错误根源
copy.tagline_en: Find and fix root causes of Python execution failures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle to find the root cause of Python errors

howto.what: 当 sandbox 执行失败时，Claude 会分三步调试：先捕获部分输出定位失败位置，再单独测试每个函数，最后逐个生成并验证文件。
howto.when: 当你使用 execute_code_sandbox 运行复杂脚本（如音频/视频生成）时，若输出不完整或报错，Claude 会触发此调试流程。

say.text: 帮我调试这个 sandbox 执行失败的脚本。
把脚本拆成小函数逐个测试。
say.note: Claude 会隔离每个函数执行。

say.text: 验证生成的每个文件是否存在。

howto.what_en: When sandbox execution fails, Claude uses a three-phase debugging approach: capture partial output to locate the failure, test each function in isolation, and generate/verify files incrementally.
howto.when_en: Triggered when execute_code_sandbox fails silently or produces incomplete output, especially with complex scripts like audio/video generation or external dependencies.

say_en.text: Debug this sandbox execution failure for me.
Break the script into smaller functions and test each.
say_en.note: Claude isolates and tests each function.
